tinh-nang.description: Explore PAO OS with AI Chief of Staff, Multi-Agent coordination, task management, AI Workflow Automation, Knowledge Graph and business system integration.
tinh-nang.title: Explore PAO OS features
tinh-nang.subtitle: A shared platform for managing work, coordinating AI Agents and automating business processes.

intro.text: PAO OS is being developed as an AI-Native Business Operating System, combining work management, AI Agents and automation tools in one operating environment.
Instead of working separately with each AI application, users can organize tasks, connect data and coordinate tools through a shared coordination system.
From planning, research and content creation to customer management and reporting, PAO aims to help departments work more effectively while keeping people in control.
Features are developed in stages, and their scope of use depends on the version and deployment configuration.

sections.title: 1. PAO AI – AI Chief of Staff

blocks.text: An AI assistant to coordinate your work
PAO AI is intended to become the intelligent interaction center between users and the whole PAO OS system.
Rather than only answering questions, PAO AI aims to receive requests, analyze goals, plan steps and coordinate tools to help carry out work.
Users can interact in natural language without operating each application directly.
**Core capabilities:**

items: Receive requests and analyze task content.
Help develop plans and identify processing steps.
Coordinate work with suitable AI Agents or tools.
Bring information and results together from several sources.
Track progress and help manage tasks.
Ask for confirmation before actions that require approval.

blocks.text: **PAO AI is designed to help users move from performing every action themselves to assigning work and controlling the results.**
Specialist AI Agents working together to complete tasks
A business task often calls for several areas of expertise.
For example, a marketing campaign may need market research, strategy, copywriting, creative materials and performance analysis.
PAO uses a Multi-Agent architecture to organize processing steps and coordinate AI Agents with suitable roles.
**The intended approach:**

items: Analyze and break complex tasks into smaller pieces of work.
Select AI Agents by expertise and the tools they are allowed to use.
Pass results between steps in the same process.
Track status and record the processing history.
Bring results together for users to check and approve.

blocks.text: AI Agents can be configured for research, planning, content, data analysis and other business activities.
This model provides the foundation for an **AI Workforce** — a system of AI Agents coordinating through defined tasks, permissions and processes.
A shared space for managing work and projects
Work information is often scattered across email, messages, spreadsheets and different applications.
Business Workspace aims to bring tasks, projects, plans and processing results into one management space.
Managers and staff can organize work, define responsibilities and track progress through shared processes.
**Functional areas:**

items: Manage projects, plans and tasks.
Assign responsibility and set priorities.
Track work progress and status.
Link documents and information to tasks.
Use AI to help prepare reports and work updates.
Combine tasks carried out by people and AI Agents.

blocks.text: Business Workspace connects traditional management activities with AI-assisted work processing.
Connect the creative process from an idea to publication
A finished piece of content usually goes through several steps: research, ideas, writing, design, review and publication.
PAO aims to organize this process so staff and AI Agents can work together.
**Areas of application:**

items: **Content Research:** Research topics, analyze information and find ideas.
**Content Creation:** Help write, edit and develop content to meet a request.
**Creative Support:** Prepare briefs, design ideas and materials for visual production.
**Content Workflow:** Manage assignments, revisions and review.
**Publishing Workflow:** Prepare content for publication and connect supported channels.

blocks.text: Businesses can configure workflows so AI assists with suitable steps, while people review the content and approve it before publication.
**The goal is to reduce time spent on repetitive work and let creative teams focus more on content quality.**
Organize and manage marketing across platforms
A marketing campaign may run on several channels, with advertising data and results held in different systems.
PAO is developing Marketing & Ads Management to help organize campaigns, connect information and apply AI to analysis and management.
**Feature directions:**

items: Help plan and organize marketing campaigns.
Manage tasks, content and deployment progress.
Connect compatible advertising platforms.
Help consolidate metrics and prepare performance reports.
Use AI to analyze information and suggest improvements.
Automate some steps in advertising management workflows.

blocks.text: Integrations with Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads are developed along the roadmap. Data access and actions depend on each platform’s API, account permissions and policies.
Manage customer information in the context of real work
Every customer interaction brings information that can be useful for sales and customer care.
When data is spread across channels, businesses can struggle to follow conversation histories, assign work and provide ongoing care.
PAO aims to combine CRM with AI Agents to organize information and support customer care processes.
**Intended functional areas:**

items: Manage customer profiles and information.
Track requests, interaction history and processing status.
Help categorize customers and their needs.
Use AI Agents to help prepare responses and advice.
Organize assignments, reminders and follow-up care.
Connect data from compatible CRM sources and channels.

blocks.text: AI uses information that the business permits it to access, within configured data and process boundaries.
Connect knowledge so AI understands the work context
An AI Agent needs appropriate information about tasks, documents, processes and related data to support work effectively.
If users have to provide all that information again every time, AI’s usefulness is limited.
PAO’s development direction includes knowledge management and contextual memory to help AI Agents retrieve, connect and use information while processing tasks.
**The intended architecture:**

items: Organize documents, data and information by workspace.
Connect information between projects, tasks and related entities.
Help retrieve context suited to each request.
Reduce the need to enter information that has already been stored and permitted for use.
Manage access to knowledge sources.
Help maintain context between steps in Multi-Agent processes.

blocks.text: Knowledge Graph and AI Memory are components of PAO’s knowledge management development direction. Their actual deployment scope must be determined for each product version.
Automate processes and control each step
Not every task needs AI. Many actions can be handled with simple automation rules.
For tasks that require understanding content, analyzing information or choosing an approach, however, AI can play an important supporting role.
PAO aims to bring these two capabilities together in AI Workflow Automation.
**A process may include:**

items: Receive requests or data from a connected system.
Analyze the content and determine processing conditions.
Assign tasks to suitable AI Agents or tools.
Carry out actions according to rules and permissions.
Send approval requests to authorized staff.
Store results and update task status.

blocks.text: The system is designed with permissions, approvals and activity records to help businesses track execution.
**Automate to reduce manual actions while keeping people involved in important decisions.**
Connect tools and AI models to match your needs
Businesses use different technology services, from management software to AI platforms and data services.
PAO is designed with an extensible architecture, aiming to connect AI models, APIs and business tools through compatible integration methods.
**Intended support:**

items: Connect multiple providers and AI models.
Integrate outside services through APIs and supporting tools.
Connect business data sources and applications.
Configure tools for each AI Agent according to its tasks.
Manage access permissions and integration credentials.
Develop workflows that coordinate across systems.

blocks.text: Integration capabilities depend on APIs, authentication methods, technical conditions and service providers’ policies.
This architecture helps PAO adapt to changes in AI technology and different business operating needs.
Flexible deployment with clear control
Each business has its own requirements for infrastructure, data and access boundaries.
PAO OS is being developed with a strategy to support multiple deployment environments for different usage needs.
**Cloud / VPS Edition**
The direction is to deploy PAO on servers, allowing users to access it through the web interface and configured channels.
This model suits processes that need centralized operations and several users working in the same system.
**Desktop / PC Edition**
The Desktop edition is on the development roadmap, aiming to carry out user-authorized actions on personal computers.
Permissions are designed to be limited by device, account and the authorized scope of actions.
**Security & Access Control**
PAO focuses on building controls for AI-assisted work processing:

items: Manage users and access boundaries.
Set permissions for tools and data sources.
Approve important actions.
Record history and execution status.
Limit actions according to configuration and granted permissions.
Support review of AI Agent activity.

blocks.text: The goal is to help businesses use automation while maintaining transparency and control over the system.
The core of PAO OS’s architecture is the connection between its components.
**Business Workspace** helps organize work.
**PAO AI** receives requests and helps coordinate them.
**Multi-Agent Orchestration** divides and coordinates tasks requiring several areas of expertise.
**Knowledge & Integrations** supplies data and tools within permitted boundaries.
**Workflow Automation** organizes processing steps, while permissions and approvals help users retain control.
They share a common goal: turn AI from a separate assistance tool into an organized part of business workflows.

doi-ngu.description: Meet the thinking behind PAO OS at IVN Network: product development, AI Agent expertise, software engineering and business automation.
doi-ngu.title: The PAO OS development team
doi-ngu.subtitle: Bringing together AI technology, product thinking and an understanding of business operations.

intro.text: Behind an AI system that can support work are layers of technology, processes and technical decisions that users rarely see.
From architecture and AI Agent development to data connections, permissions and automation, each component needs to be considered in relation to how businesses actually operate.
PAO OS follows that approach: start with the problem, choose suitable technology and gradually build a platform with lasting practical value.

blocks.text: Technology built around real needs
**IVN Network** develops PAO OS in Vietnam, with a focus on applying artificial intelligence and software technology to business management and operations.
Developing PAO brings together knowledge from AI Agents, software engineering, automation, product design and digital business.
We do not see adding another AI model or tool as the final goal.
What matters more is what work that technology can help users do, how it can work with existing systems and whether it offers enough control for a business environment.
**PAO OS is being built to bring AI closer to real work, rather than making businesses change how they work just to fit the technology.**
Start with the problem, not the feature
Every business organizes work, uses data and coordinates people in its own way.
One process may need AI for research or analysis. Another may only need simple automation rules. Some work still needs a person to check it and make the decision directly.
Developing PAO therefore starts with understanding the process, identifying steps that can be improved and choosing a suitable approach.
We prioritize features with clear practical value, rather than adding so much technology that the system becomes complicated.
Build a platform that can connect
An AI-powered business operating system needs more than a chat interface.
PAO’s architectural direction includes AI Agent coordination, task management, tool and data connections, permissions and records of execution.
These components need to work together in one process, while adapting to changes in outside AI services and software.
This is one of PAO OS’s technical priorities: build a flexible platform that can keep developing as technology and business needs change.
Automation comes with responsibility
AI can help handle many tasks, but not every action should be automated.
Actions involving customer data, business accounts, budgets or operating systems need appropriate limits and controls.
PAO is being developed with access management, activity records and approval requirements for important actions.
**We aim for an AI system that can help carry out work while letting users understand and control what is happening.**
Develop in stages and keep improving
AI technology changes quickly. A product that serves businesses over time needs regular updates, testing and improvement.
PAO OS has been introduced to the market and continues to be developed in stages.
Development focuses on refining functionality, improving operations, expanding suitable integrations and assessing real usage needs.
We see user feedback, test results and issues encountered during deployment as important evidence for deciding what to develop next.
Building an AI-powered Business Operating System requires several areas of knowledge and expertise to work together.
AI Engineering & Multi-Agent Systems
Researching and developing AI Agent architectures, task coordination, language model connections and processes involving multiple AI Agents.
The goal is to help AI take part in multi-step work, rather than only answering separate requests.
Software Engineering & Infrastructure
Designing software architecture, developing backend and frontend systems, managing databases and building deployment environments.
Performance, maintainability, security and stability are considered throughout product development.
Business Process & Automation
Analyzing how businesses organize work, identifying repetitive actions and designing processes that combine automation with AI.
The focus is on clear, trackable workflows that fit actual operating conditions.
Product Design & User Experience
Designing interfaces, information structures and interactions so users can approach complex AI capabilities more simply.
A good product helps users understand what to do, where the system is in a process and when a decision is needed.
Digital Business & Marketing Technology
Researching AI applications in marketing, advertising, sales, customer care and business management.
This business knowledge helps guide PAO’s features around usage needs, rather than technical possibilities alone.
Practical applications. Flexible technology. Clear control.
We believe a valuable AI product needs to balance three things:
**Solve the right problem**
Technology needs to relate to specific user tasks and needs.
**Support long-term development**
The architecture needs enough flexibility to add features, change AI models and connect new services when needed.
**Keep people in control**
AI can help plan, process information and carry out permitted tasks. Users still need to oversee, review and decide on important actions.
These principles guide PAO OS’s development at IVN Network.

blog.title: PAO Insights
blog.subtitle: Explore AI technology. Understand how it works. Apply it to real work.

intro.text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work, from simple tasks to complex business processes.

New AI models, tools and methods keep appearing every day. But between what technology can do and effective real-world use, there are always questions to explore: data, costs, integration, security and reliability.
**PAO Insights** shares knowledge, technology analysis and practical perspectives on AI Agents, automation and changing the way we work with artificial intelligence.
The content is developed for business managers, marketing teams, technology professionals and anyone who wants to better understand how AI can support their work.

blocks.text: 1. AI Agent & Multi-Agent Systems
**Understand how AI moves from answering questions to helping carry out work.**
AI Agents are opening up a new approach to applying artificial intelligence.
Instead of only responding with content, AI Agent systems can be designed to plan, use tools and participate in tasks that involve multiple steps.
This category explains the concepts, operating principles and architecture behind these systems.
**Topics to explore:**

items: What is an AI Agent, and how does it differ from a traditional chatbot?
Multi-Agent Systems and how multiple AI agents cooperate.
AI Chief of Staff and the model of an assistant that coordinates work.
Agent Orchestration, Tool Calling and task management.
AI memory, context and tool use.
Limitations and risks when deploying AI Agents.

blocks.text: From foundational knowledge to deeper technical issues, this category helps readers understand how to build and apply AI systems that can carry out work.
2. AI in business management & operations
**Bring AI into business operations, starting with specific problems.**
Effective AI adoption does not have to begin with a large system or complicated investments.
Sometimes, reducing time spent compiling reports, automatically categorizing requests or supporting task management can already make a meaningful difference.
This category shares approaches to AI from the perspectives of management, operations and process organization.
**Topics to explore:**

items: What is a Business Operating System?
Use cases for AI in business management.
AI Workflow Automation and process automation.
Applying AI to project and task management.
Connecting AI with ERP, CRM and business software.
Choosing the right process for an initial AI application.
Assessing costs, effectiveness and deployment risks.

blocks.text: The content helps managers understand which problems technology can solve, what to prepare and how to assess effectiveness in practical terms.
3. AI Marketing & Sales
**Apply artificial intelligence to marketing, sales and customer service.**
AI is supporting many marketing and business activities, from market research and content creation to data analysis and handling customer interactions.
However, effectiveness depends not only on the AI tool selected, but also on how data is organized, systems are connected and workflows are designed.
This category focuses on ways to apply AI in marketing and sales.
**Topics to explore:**

items: AI Marketing Automation and application models.
Using AI for market research and planning.
AI Content Creation in content production.
AI support for managing Meta, Google and TikTok advertising.
AI CRM and customer information management.
Sales chatbots and customer service automation.
Connecting marketing data and analyzing campaign effectiveness.

blocks.text: Articles focus on practical applications, integration requirements and the limitations to consider when using AI in business.
4. AI Engineering & Open Source
**Explore the technology behind modern AI systems.**
To build an AI application for real work, the language model is only one part of the system.
Components such as APIs, databases, orchestration tools, memory, infrastructure and security mechanisms all affect how it operates.
AI Engineering & Open Source is for developers, software engineers and people who want a deeper understanding of AI system architecture.
**Topics to explore:**

items: LLM APIs and integrating language models.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool connections.
AI Agent Frameworks and Multi-Agent architectures.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Knowledge Graphs.
Open-source projects for AI development.
Deploying AI applications on Cloud, VPS and Desktop.
Managing tokens, API costs and processing performance.
Security, access control and monitoring AI Agent activity.

blocks.text: Technical content prioritizes explaining principles, analyzing deployment options and examining issues that may arise when systems enter operation.
5. PAO Development & Product Updates
**Follow the development of PAO OS.**
PAO OS is being developed to combine task management, AI Agent orchestration and business automation in one platform.
PAO Development provides publicly announced information about the product, its development process and planned improvements.
**Content includes:**

items: Release announcements and feature updates.
Introductions to components of the PAO OS architecture.
Changes to the interface and user workflows.
Updates on integration and deployment capabilities.
Insights into design and engineering decisions.
The development roadmap and functions being researched.

blocks.text: Information clearly distinguishes released features, functions in development and future directions.
It is also a place where users can learn how PAO OS is built and refined at each stage.
If you are new to AI Agents or considering AI for your business, the topics below offer a suitable starting point.
What is an AI Agent? How it works and practical applications
Explore the AI Agent concept, how AI uses tools and handles tasks, and how it differs from a typical chatbot.
What is a Multi-Agent System? When several AIs work together
Explore task allocation, AI Agent coordination and organizing processes that require multiple processing steps.
What is a Business Operating System?
Learn about the business operating system concept and how an orchestration platform can connect work, data and existing software.
AI Workflow Automation: When should you use AI?
Distinguish rules-based automation from workflows involving AI, and learn how to choose an appropriate approach.
Applying AI in small and medium-sized businesses
What SMEs should consider before deploying AI, from work requirements and data to costs and operational capabilities.
How does AI Marketing Automation work?
Explore how AI can support research, content creation, campaign management and marketing analysis.

sections.title: Knowledge matters when it can be applied

blocks.text: PAO Insights is built on a simple view: **understanding technology properly matters more than following every new trend.**
We focus on three editorial principles:
**Clear and accessible**
Technical concepts are explained in understandable terms so both technology professionals and business users can engage with them.
**Grounded in reliable information**
Analysis prioritizes technical documentation, trustworthy references and verifiable information. We distinguish theoretical capabilities, experiments and confirmed applications.
**Connected to real work**
Alongside explaining technology, content addresses problems users need to solve: choosing tools, building processes, managing costs and assessing effectiveness.
PAO Insights does not aim to present AI as the answer to every problem. Its goal is to give readers more knowledge to select and apply technology appropriately.
PAO Insights is a technology knowledge publication in the **PAO OS** ecosystem, developed by **IVN Network** in Vietnam.
Through specialist articles, technical analysis and application-focused content, we hope to help make AI more understandable, accessible and useful for businesses and technology professionals.

intro.text: Every business has different requirements for infrastructure, data and how it uses technology.
PAO OS is being developed to support multiple deployment environments, from Cloud/VPS servers to personal computers, helping users choose an option suited to their work.
Whether running on a server or a personal device, PAO pursues the same goal: connecting work, AI Agents and tools in an organized, extensible system controlled by the user.

blocks.text: PAO OS Cloud / VPS
**An AI operating system for server and business environments.**
PAO OS Cloud/VPS is being developed for server-based operation, allowing users to work through a web interface and configured connection channels.
Rather than installing the entire system on every computer, a business can deploy PAO in a centralized environment to organize work and coordinate AI Agents.
**Planned capabilities:**

items: Access the system through a web interface.
Organize work, projects and processes in a centralized environment.
Coordinate AI Agents and tools by task.
Connect AI models and external services.
Manage users, access rights and approval steps.
Monitor processing status and system activity.

blocks.text: **Self-hosted AI Agent**
PAO aims to support deployment on a business's own VPS, giving customers control over infrastructure providers, server resources and the AI services they need.
This option suits businesses with specific requirements for their operating environment, system integration or resource management.
Deployment must meet the technical requirements and support scope of the relevant PAO edition.
**Suited to:**

items: Small and medium-sized businesses.
Teams working across multiple locations.
Organizations needing centralized task management.
Businesses wanting to deploy AI Agents on their own infrastructure.

blocks.text: **Status:** In development, with deployment arrangements being refined.
PAO OS Desktop / PC
**Bring AI closer to work on personal computers.**
Not all work takes place on web platforms.
Many tasks require interaction with data files, installed applications or resources available only on a personal computer.
PAO Desktop is planned to support these needs through an AI Desktop Agent, combining AI processing with tools the user authorizes on their device.
**Planned capabilities:**

items: Interact with AI Agents from a desktop environment.
Support tasks involving authorized files and folders.
Connect compatible local applications and tools.
Coordinate tasks between the user and AI.
Support automation workflows on the computer.
Control the scope of actions and resource access.

blocks.text: **Users remain in control**
The ability to act on a computer must come with clear limits.
PAO Desktop is being designed to act only within granted permissions, require confirmation for important actions and let users control AI Agent activity.
**Suited to:**

items: Individuals and independent professionals.
Developers and users of technical tools.
Staff who frequently work with desktop software.
Businesses with processes dependent on local resources.

blocks.text: **Status:** On the development roadmap; no official installer has been announced.
The right choice depends on the working environment, data types and tasks the business wants AI to support.

Prepare a suitable environment before deployment
PAO OS may have different technical requirements depending on the edition and connected AI services.
**For Cloud/VPS**
Factors to consider include:

items: Supported server operating systems and environments.
CPU, RAM and storage capacity.
Network connectivity and security configuration.
AI services, API Keys and integration accounts.
Databases and supporting components for the edition.
Backup, update and monitoring arrangements.

blocks.text: **For Desktop/PC**
Requirements to establish include:

items: Compatible operating systems.
Minimum hardware specifications.
Access permissions for files, applications and device resources.
Internet connectivity and required AI services.
Installation, update and recovery mechanisms.

blocks.text: Minimum specifications and supported operating systems will be announced for each verified release.
Bring AI into the working environment step by step
PAO deployment is planned around four steps:
**01. Choose an environment**
Identify usage needs, the Cloud/VPS or Desktop model and infrastructure requirements.
**02. Prepare configuration**
Set up the environment, accounts, data sources and AI services to connect.
**03. Connect and test**
Configure AI Agents and access rights, and test processing workflows within the supported scope.
**04. Operate and update**
Monitor activity, manage permissions, back up data and apply appropriate updates.
For businesses needing system integration or deployment on their own infrastructure, the scope of work will be assessed against actual technical conditions.
PAO OS is developed and refined in stages.
Version information, installation documentation and compatibility details need to be published for each official release.
Users should use distribution sources confirmed by PAO OS, check version information and back up important data before upgrading.
Experimental versions may have limitations in functionality, integration and stability.
**Choose the right environment. Connect the right tools. Build a suitable workflow.**
PAO OS aims to help businesses and individuals access AI Agent systems in a flexible, organized and controllable way.
If you are interested in deploying PAO on Cloud/VPS, integrating AI Agents into existing systems or following the Desktop edition, contact us for release information and supported deployment options.
